desc:
💥 Mega Ragdoll Sandbox is a single player sandbox game with reactive ragdolls, 100+ weapons, 45+ animals like wolves and dinosaurs, placeable objects, 10+ maps and more!

🧍 Reactive Ragdolls
Ragdolls don’t just tumble when hit. They react, run away, fight back, hold their injuries and react to other ragdolls!

🐺 Realistic Creatures
Creatures act like the real thing. They pounce, drag, bite, and some even swallow their prey whole!

🩺 Doctor Mode
Each ragdoll has nearly every organ in the body, and doctor mode shows you what’s been damaged or changed.

🌪️ World Events
Tornadoes, tsunamis, meteor showers, alien invasions, nukes and more on any map with up to 150 NPCs!

🎮 Inspired by other sandbox games on Roblox and beyond. Have fun! 🔥
